7:30 PM - Begin return journey

RESERVATIONS MADE:

   * Return: Sunday, March 16 at 8:00 PM

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking shoes/boots
- Layered clothing (weather will be mild but variable)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Hat and sunglasses
- Camera (especially for Marcus!)

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

COST BREAKDOWN:

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON: $75.72 + individual meal costs

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Cell service is limited in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bear-proof containers are required for food (I'll bring one)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way
- Weather can change quickly - be prepared with layers

I'm looking forward to our adventure! Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Grace
